title: A month ago I launched my AI pixel art generator....here’s how it’s going
author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
selftext:
About a month ago, I released my AI pixel art and sprite sheet generator, [pixelartgen.com](http://pixelartgen.com), and things have been going well. I recently added a new top-down view feature, currently supporting the walking animation (with more to come). Over 100 users have joined so far, and I’ve made my first two sales (Yay!!), huge thanks to everyone who supported the project!



The primary goal of PixelArtGen is to bring multiple creative tools together, so users don’t need separate subscriptions for each sprite or animation generator. I’m also planning to add more generators commonly used by other creators.



All registered users received 20 free credits to try the latest updates. Progress was a bit slower while I set up the terms, privacy policy, onboarding, and analytics. But now that’s done, I can fully focus on improving the generation system.



I’m also starting a community to share updates, new features, and progress. If you have any feedbacks , features req or suggestions....Definitely let me know :)

comments.author: Limp_Biscuit_Choco
comments.body: You’ve nailed a useful niche, delivered clear value, and structured the offering in a way that makes sense for your target users. With some added polish around showing off work, clarifying value, and building community/trust, it can scale more effectively. Is this also vibe coded?

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body:
Thanks a lot for the appreciation and I have huge plans for expanding it to more types of game assets and yes this is vibe coded. There are some layout/scaling issues here and there  since its vibe coded. But I know I can resolve it eventually.  
  
My main focus after publishing it for the first time was to refactor and organise scripts properly so that I can escalate it to long term use. Once again thank you and stay tuned for more updates :)

replies.author: Limp_Biscuit_Choco
replies.body: That's the spirit! why not share it on platforms too? most builders I know share their vibe coded projects on vibecodinglist for wide users and explorers as well as real feedback from them and the other builders. Might help your project's growth

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body: Oh, I see...thanks for the suggestions. I only knew about the major platforms like Product Hunt, so it’s my first time hearing about the ones you mentioned. Some other users also suggested sharing it on different platforms as well. Thanks again 😄 I’ll do that shortly

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body: Hey man, I have to thank you for introducing me to vibecodinglist . It's truly amazing. I've been getting multiple solid feedback on how to improve the tool. Once again , thank you bro

comments.author: CulturalFig1237
comments.body: That sounds really promising, especially with the plan to expand into more game types. Do you think future updates will also let users customize styles or create pixel art from simple sketches?

replies.author: Spiritual-Bus-9903
replies.body: Yes definitely... I have made plans for more user customisation for their ai content , stay tuned for more updates :)

replies.author: CulturalFig1237
replies.body: Oh, I can't wait for more 😊😊
